name: Hair, beauty or wellness salon
description: A hairdresser, barber, beauty, nail, massage or wellness salon: the services, a price list, the team and clients' questions, with facts about booking, the products used, gift vouchers and cancellations.

questions.question: How do clients book an appointment?
questions.help: For example "online on this site, by phone or by a message; walk-ins when a chair is free".

questions.question: Do you use an outside online booking system? Give its address.
questions.help: Leave it empty if you use Bookings in Talea – the Booking element on the site then takes appointments – or if clients book by phone.

questions.question: Which products or brands do you work with?
questions.help: Name a brand partnership or certified salon status only if the brand has granted it to you.

questions.question: Do you sell gift vouchers? How can people get one, and how long is it valid?
questions.help: For example "any amount, in the salon or by e-mail, valid 12 months". Leave it empty if you do not sell them.

questions.question: How far ahead must clients cancel, and what happens if they do not come?
questions.help: In your own words, e.g. "cancel at least 24 hours ahead, otherwise we charge 50 % of the service".

questions.question: Can clients in a wheelchair or with a pram get into the salon?
questions.help: Describe it as it is, e.g. "ground floor, no steps" or "first floor, no lift".

questions.question: Since which year has the salon been open?

audit.message: Add the services you offer, each with what it includes and how long it takes.
The price list has not changed for a year – check that the prices are still right.
Introduce your team – clients often book with a particular person.
Say how clients book an appointment – it is what they look for first.
State your cancellation policy so that clients know it before they book.
Add your opening hours in Business details.

claude: Clients want to see what the salon does, what it costs, who will do it and how to book – put the services with prices, the team and a clear booking button at the top. When the Bookings feature is on, place the Booking element on the booking page and the service pages so clients pick a service, a person and a free time; otherwise link the button to {{fact.booking_url}} or the phone. Keep the price list current and say "from" where the price depends on hair length or the treatment. Never make health or medical claims, never promise results (younger skin, hair growth, weight or cellulite loss) and do not call a treatment therapy unless the owner says so. Never invent staff, qualifications, certificates, brands, before-and-after photos or reviews; photos of clients only with their consent.
